entry.name: drunk
entry.digest: Output random numbers within a step range
entry.description: Performs a "drunken" walk by outputting random numbers within a specified step range.

arguments.name: maximum value
arguments.digest: Set the maximum number for output
arguments.description: Sets the maximum number produced. If this argument is not provided, the maximum value is set to. Inmode, the default maximum value is. By default, the minimum value produced is, but this can be overridden with theattribute.If this argument is a floating-point value,will be enabled, and the object will generate floating-point output.

arguments.name: step size
arguments.description: Sets an initial limit on the size of random steps taken; the absolute value of the step size will always be less than (inmode, less than or equal to) the absolute value of this limit. attributes.name: seed
attributes.digest: Random Seed
attributes.description: Theattribute sets the state of the random number generator. Whenis 0 (the default),uses the time elapsed since system startup as the seed. Whenis non-zero, the value is used to initialize ("seed") the random number generator, resulting in the same predictable but statistically random sequence. You can reset the random number generator state by changingor with themessage.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Causesto take a step of random size up or down from its currently stored value. It updates the stored value and outputs it.

messages.name: float
messages.description: Inmode, the functions are the same, but in the floating-point domain. Whenis disabled, arriving values are converted toduring processing.

messages.name: int
messages.description: In the left inlet: Replace the current value, send new value to the outlet.In the middle inlet: Set the maximum value that can be output by theobject. If the specified maximum is less than 0 it is set to.In the right inlet: Set the step size taken in response to ain the left inlet. The step (up or down) will always be less than (inmode, less than or equal to) the absolute value of this number.

messages.name: reset
messages.description: With no arguments, themessage resets the cycle counter to zero. (The cycle counter is used when theattribute is non-zero.) When an optional int argument is present,assigns that value to the cycle counter and "fast-forwards" from the beginning of the cycle so that the next output value will be at the specified cycle position.is useful immediately after changing theorto ensure the cycle starts or continues a consistent pattern.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Set the stored value, no output
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the stored value to that number without triggering output. The stored value is initially set in the center of the total range (half of the maximum value).

messages.name: setresetvalue
messages.description: With no arguments, themessage assigns the most recent output value to be the value assigned when a cycle reset occurs. With an int argument sets the reset value to a specific number.
